content: Jon tikin Baptais ŋanange nalaŋatme wusyep
Ŋup uku pe, Jon tikin Baptais nal moi gungurar ŋaiye nato provins Judia pe, kin ŋanange nalaŋatme wusyep tikin Got.
Kin ŋanange na, “Yimbilme ŋoihmbwaip yusme pupwa. Detale, lemame tikin moihlaꞌ si nat sehei.”
Jon kin miyeꞌ ŋaiye profet Aisaia ŋanange wusyep me kin. Profet Aisaia ŋanange na,

content.text: Miyeꞌ ende kin gal gal ŋanange wusyep gan na tas moi gungurar
Pe kin ŋanange na, “Yende miꞌmiꞌ me yaŋah me Lahmborenge,
yiche yihyete yaŋah me kin ŋaiye ka bwore yelme!”

content: Hihyilih Jon ŋaiye gah pe, tinge yenge yuwor waih kamel ende.
Kin terŋeme mwah ŋap gah mondom kin. O ŋai kin pe, ki ŋono sipit topoꞌe wiŋe yihim ŋaiye yarp syipsyap.
Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ŋaiye yatme kin pe, tinge yase moi embere Jerusalem yat, topoꞌe provins Judia lalme, topoꞌe moi lalme ŋaiye sai sehei me mih Jordan.
Tinge yanange yoworꞌe yember pupwa ŋaiye tinge yende pe, kin gihyeꞌe lenge pinip na gah mih Jordan.

Kom ŋupe ŋaiye kin ŋetekeꞌe lenge Sadyusi topoꞌe lenge Farisi wula yatme kin ŋaiye ka gihyeꞌe lenge pinip pe, kin ŋana lenge na, “Yip lenge talah tikin hwaŋ pupwa. Lahmende ŋana yip ŋaiye yip de pa jirnge tupwaihme ŋoihmbwaip nihe tikin Got ŋaiye ka ot?
Pa yasamb lenge yarp bworere yip no, ka sisyeme nange yip si yimbilme ŋoihmbwaip yip.

Yukur pa ŋoiheryembe yil yoto ŋoihmbwaip yip tuꞌe leꞌe, ‘O Abraham kin yai loumwah poi kili. Taꞌe luku pe, poi si bwore bwarme mal ŋembep tikin Got.’ Ŋam mana yip bwore mise! Got tatame ŋaiye ka ende ŋeser eꞌe ka tuꞌe ŋaiye ŋambaih talah tikin Abraham.
Hei, yisyunde! Ŋim ŋeser si ŋende miꞌmiꞌ ŋanar ŋaiye ka gine lou eteme lou tehei. Lou lalme ŋaiye yukur teŋei esep bworerme pe, ka jene yiche yil yunuh nih.

Ŋam jaih yip pinip pakaiye masamb yip wutuꞌ taꞌe ŋaiye yip si yimbilme ŋoihmbwaip. Kom miyeꞌ ŋaiye ka ot gunde ŋam pe, ka jih yip Yohe Yirise topoꞌe nih. Miyeꞌ ŋaiye ka ot gunde ŋam pe, bongol kin nengelyembe ŋam. Ŋam yukur miyeꞌ bwore tatame ŋaiye ma mungul ŋihip hiꞌ kin.

Kin ŋende miꞌmiꞌ narp ŋaiye ka iyarꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye bwore angaꞌme lenge pupwa. Ka ende ŋahilyeh tuꞌe miyeꞌ wah ŋaiye ŋendere me kakah esep, topoꞌe gurngur hoporonge. Kin nember kakah esep ŋaiye bwore nato yokoh ŋai kin. Kut ŋaiye gurngur topoꞌe hoporonge pe, ka esekeh el nih ŋaiye riri sai nyermbe nyermbe. Yukur ka oip.”
Jon gihyeꞌe pinip me Jisas
Ŋup uku pe, Jisas nase moi jeheinge nato distrik Galili nat nal mih Jordan ŋaiye Jon ka gihyeꞌe pinip me kin.
Kom Jon plihe bunjenge ŋoihmbwaip kin ŋanange na, “Nin na pingih pinip me ŋam. O detaꞌe lai ti ni natme ŋam?”

Pe Jisas nungwisme wusyep kin na, “Kom ŋaiye tukwini pe, osme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe ka el gunde tuꞌe luku. Ŋaiye ya mende tuꞌe luku pe, ka el gunde ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye Got ŋasande.” Taꞌe luku pe, Jon ŋenerme wusyep kin.
Ŋupe ŋaiye Jisas nambaꞌe pinip miꞌe no, kin nasme pinip nate ŋanah. Pe moihlaꞌ ginir pe, kin ŋetekeꞌe yipihinge tikin Got nate gah taꞌe jesumbihnip ŋaiye narp anah kin.
Miꞌe pe, tinge yisande wusyep diꞌ ende nase moihlaꞌ nat ŋanange na, “Leꞌe talah bwore ŋam pe,

footnotes.text: 3.4 Yuwor kamel taꞌe yuwor hos. Wusyep ŋaiye hihyilih topoꞌe ŋai Jon pe, kin nalaŋatme ŋaiye kin profet ende taꞌe Elaija ŋaiye somohonme.
